reverse_orphan_checks: Every authoritative command has one route or exact internal shared-UoW caller, one idempotency boundary, audit policy and concrete tests.
Every query has deterministic total ordering, bounded pagination semantics where applicable, supporting index evidence and concrete tests.
Every governing requirement reaches at least one non-test normative leaf and one test leaf.
No reference history table has an ordinary delete authority and no credential authority originates in LLD-02.
